verdict.rationale: Insomnia documents team collaboration via 'organizations' for sharing collections/environments securely, RBAC for granular access control, and both Cloud Sync and Git Sync for storing/synchronizing shared project data, plus conflict resolution UI for Git-based sync. This directly satisfies the shared-workspace story for teams. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of real-time team sync experience and more detail on Cloud Sync conflict handling beyond the Git Sync merge view.
